meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,默认存到源文档旁边;若配好上传凭据,还会返回一个手机端分享链接。文档太薄时它会先写一份长文。
howto.when: 当你说「wowerpoint 这个」「给<文件>做一份幻灯片」等说法,或要求把某份文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时接管。

say.note: 会自动建笔记本、生成并下载 PDF

say.text: 把这份报告变成幻灯片,用 kawaii 角色讲故事
say.note: 你给的生成提示词会原样传入

say.text: 用 default 长度重新生成一遍
say.note: 复用已有笔记本和源,只重跑生成与下载

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii slide-deck PDF via NotebookLM, saved next to the source. With upload credentials set, it also returns a mobile share link; a too-thin source is written out long-form first.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'wowerpoint this', 'make a deck about <file>', or 'turn this report into slides', or any request to render one document as narrative slides.

say_en.note: Builds a notebook, generates and downloads the PDF

say_en.text: Turn this report into slides with kawaii characters
say_en.note: Your generation prompt is passed through verbatim

say_en.text: Regenerate it with the default length
say_en.note: Reuses the notebook and source, reruns generation
